nodes.label: .github CLAUDE.md Policy
nodes.rationale: Ensures PRs into develop/main run policy, check, build, test gates; keeps deploy jobs serialized and dependent on verification to avoid unsafe production deploys.

nodes.label: docs/GIT_FLOW.md
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for branches, commits, PRs, hotfixes, and release automation.

nodes.label: docs/RELEASE_<version>_PLAN.md
nodes.rationale: Release-specific target-state plans; must not describe unmet gates as already implemented.

nodes.label: Font Assets README
nodes.rationale: Documents self-hosted WOFF2 fonts (Nunito, Comfortaa, JetBrains Mono) under SIL OFL 1.1 with SHA-256 integrity list.

nodes.label: Design QA — reusable room and chat menus
nodes.rationale: Final visual/behavioral QA report for the reusable room/chat menu, hover toolbar and reaction picker rework; concludes 'passed' with 0 P0/P1/P2 findings.

nodes.label: ADR: Unicode authority for message reactions
nodes.rationale: Sole authority is Unicode emoji-test.txt (Emoji 17.0), accepting only fully-qualified sequences to give deterministic reaction eligibility before any package manifest changes.

nodes.label: VoiceRoom 2.5 Architecture Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Records release 2.5 brownfield ownership gates for the modular monolith without creating placeholder domain modules.

nodes.label: docs/CLAUDE.md governance rules
nodes.rationale: GIT_FLOW.md is the authoritative workflow; release plans describe required target state and must not be marked complete without fresh evidence.

nodes.label: Git Flow workflow
nodes.rationale: Authoritative development/release workflow for humans and agents; release plans may add gates but may not bypass it.

nodes.label: VoiceRoom monitoring agent
nodes.rationale: VoiceRoom itself runs no Prometheus/Grafana/monitoring code; a separate private VoiceRoomStatus stack scrapes standard exporter endpoints over Tailscale.

nodes.label: Release 2.4.0 verification plan
nodes.rationale: Release owner explicitly accepted a dev-audio-smoke evidence gap to approve 2.4.0.

nodes.label: Release 2.4.1 verification plan
nodes.rationale: No schema/storage-format change; scope covers profile resolution and context-menu viewport-edge regression coverage.

nodes.label: Release 2.4.2 hotfix verification plan
nodes.rationale: Screen-share hotfix: preserve remote screen audio/presence across unsubscribe/unpublish/republish.

nodes.label: VoiceRoom 2.5.0 consolidated execution plan
nodes.rationale: Superseded per-G-number branch granularity with 9 subsystem delivery branches (B01-B09).

nodes.label: VoiceRoom 2.5.0 unified messaging platform PRD
nodes.rationale: One backwards-compatible product minor absorbing confirmed targets previously split across 2.5.0/2.6.0/2.7.0.

nodes.label: VoiceRoom 2.5.0 Unified — Verification and Release Evidence Specification
nodes.rationale: A green command without exact SHA, environment, artifact checksum, review identities and prerequisite state is diagnostic, not a merge or release gate — evidence must be exact and reproducible.

nodes.label: Release 2.6.0 Plan — Engagement & Notifications (Superseded)
nodes.rationale: Retained only for rationale; its confirmed scope is absorbed into the unified 2.5.0 plan, so unmet gates are not implemented merely by that absorption.

nodes.label: Release 2.7.0 Plan — Media & Moderation (Superseded)
nodes.rationale: Retained only for rationale; scope absorbed into unified 2.5.0 plan.

nodes.label: Expiry-Aware Rescue Profile Doc (G85)
nodes.rationale: A read-safe rescue image lets operators roll back after temporary-ban writes exist without losing active-ban correctness, since literal v2.4.2 binary rollback is unsafe post-activation.

nodes.label: Coordinated Media Backup and Restore Doc
Release 2.5.0 RC Preflight Doc
nodes.rationale: Preflight only validates; it never itself creates the release branch, builds images, or deploys, keeping validation and action separated.

nodes.label: Release 2.5.0 Repairs README
nodes.rationale: No repair is authorized until a valid external G01 selection exists, preventing pre-bootstrap edits from masquerading as authorized fixes.

nodes.label: packages/CLAUDE.md Guidance
nodes.rationale: shared/ is the compatibility boundary between API and Web, so contract evolution must stay backward-compatible or go through a release plan.

nodes.label: VoiceRoom App Icon (Owl Mascot Mark on Dark Rounded Square)
nodes.rationale: A lime-green stylized owl/headset silhouette with two round eyes over a black horizontal band, on a dark rounded-square background — used as the app favicon/icon.

nodes.label: VoiceRoom Mascot Mark (Masked Owl Silhouette, Transparent)
nodes.rationale: Same owl silhouette as the icon but rendered on a transparent background with the horizontal band masked out (as a cutout) instead of filled, for use where a solid background isn't wanted.
